#  Title:Deforming integrable models of AdS_3 strings
Authors:[Jacek Pawelczyk](https://arxiv.org/search/hep-th?searchtype=author&query=Pawelczyk,+J)
View a PDF of the paper titled Deforming integrable models of AdS$_3$ strings, by Jacek Pawelczyk
[View PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2111.07453) [HTML (experimental)](https://arxiv.org/html/2111.07453v2)
> Abstract:We discuss an integrable model of string on AdS_3xS^3xT^4 in a thermodynamical bath. We show that scattering of the excitations above equilibrium states has some novel features. Thermodynamics points to interesting deformation of the original model for which we discuss finite size effect through mirror TBA equations.
